verdict.rationale: Granola Chat acts as a built-in AI assistant that users can delegate tasks to — asking it to draft/send follow-up emails, draft Slack messages, find times and create calendar events, and answer questions across meeting notes — all documented as in-product agentic workflows rather than external integrations. Missing for 10: independent/hands-on verification of the delegation workflows actually executing multi-step actions reliably, and clearer detail on the assistant's autonomy/error-handling beyond docs.
